query.raw_text: Procurement of 1100 V grade 4-core 240 sq mm crosslinked polyethylene XLPE insulated stranded aluminium conductor armoured cable with galvanized steel strip armour and extruded PVC outer sheath.

technical_requirements.target_product: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables: Part 1 For Working Voltage Up to and Including 1100 V
technical_requirements.material_grade: XLPE insulation, aluminium conductor, GI strip armour

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard for XLPE insulated thermoplastic sheathed cables: Part 1 For working voltage up to and including 1100 V.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Prescribes the requirements for XLPE insulated cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Same XLPE cable series, but Part 2 is for higher voltages 3.3 kV up to 33 kV.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Tender asks for 1100 V grade, which is strictly governed by Part 1, not medium/high voltage Part 2.
Tender specifies XLPE insulation, which has higher thermal rating than PVC.

query.raw_text: Supply of 11/0.433 kV, 100 kVA outdoor oil immersed step-down distribution transformer, 3-phase 50 Hz, copper winding with off-circuit tap changer and energy efficiency level 2.

technical_requirements.product: Distribution Transformers Up to 2500 kVA, 33 kV
technical_requirements.target_product: Outdoor/Indoor Type Oil Immersed Distribution Transformers Up to and Including 2500 kVA, 33 kV
technical_requirements.material_grade: CRGO electrical steel core, electrolytic copper winding

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard specification for outdoor/indoor type oil immersed distribution transformers up to and including 2500 kVA, 33 kV.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1.1: Specifies requirements and tests for outdoor/indoor type oil immersed distribution transformers.

hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Distribution transformers up to 2500 kVA fall strictly under IS 1180 (Part 1) under national QCO.
Tender explicitly requires oil-immersed transformers, not dry-type cast resin.

query.raw_text: Supply of polymer-modified cementitious tile adhesive Type 2 for fixing ceramic, vitrified and mosaic tiles on internal and external walls and floors in new terminal building concourses.

technical_requirements.target_product: Adhesives for Use with Ceramic, Mosaic and Stone Tiles - Specification
technical_requirements.application: Fixing vitrified and ceramic tiles on walls and floors

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard for adhesives for use with ceramic, mosaic and stone tiles.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Prescribes the requirements for adhesives for use with ceramic, mosaic and stone tiles.

hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 13630 is for ceramic tile sampling and testing, whereas IS 15477 is the adhesive product standard.
IS 15622 is for the tiles themselves, not the adhesive used to fix them.

query.raw_text: Procurement of high alumina cement for structural applications and refractory castable linings in steel melting shop furnaces.

technical_requirements.product: High Alumina Cement for Structural Use
technical_requirements.target_product: High Alumina Cement for Structural Use - Specification
technical_requirements.application: Structural and high temperature refractory concrete

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard specification for high alumina cement for structural use.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Prescribes the requirements for manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of high alumina cement for structural use.

hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 269 covers ordinary Portland cement with silicate chemistry, completely different from aluminate chemistry under IS 6452.
IS 6909 is supersulphated cement, not calcium aluminate high alumina cement.

query.raw_text: Supply of sulphate resisting Portland cement for heavy pile cap and maritime wharf jetty substructure exposed to aggressive marine tidal waters.

technical_requirements.target_product: Specification for Sulphate Resisting Portland Cement
technical_requirements.application: Marine concrete substructure and sulphate-rich soil

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard specification for sulphate resisting Portland cement.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Prescribes the requirements for manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of sulphate resisting Portland cement.

hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Ordinary Portland cement contains up to 10% C3A and is susceptible to severe ettringite sulphate attack in marine waters.
IS 12600 is designed for low heat of hydration in dams, not chemical sulphate resistance.

query.raw_text: Supply of flexible travelling trailing electric cables for passenger elevator shafts, elastomer/rubber insulated flexible multicore rated up to 1100 V for lift cars in underground stations.

technical_requirements.target_product: Flexible Cables for Lifts and Other Flexible Applications Part 1 Elastomer Insulated Cables

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard for flexible cables for lifts and other flexible applications: Part 1 Elastomer insulated cables.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Covers the requirements of elastomer insulated flexible cables for lifts and other flexible applications.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: General PVC building flexible wires standard.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Standard PVC building wires lack high fatigue flex life required for travelling elevator cars.
IS 4289 (Part 1) specifically governs lift travelling applications, whereas IS 9968 is general elastomer cables.

query.raw_text: Procurement of granulated blast furnace slag from iron manufacturing plant for the manufacture of Portland slag cement meeting national chemical and physical specification requirements.

technical_requirements.product: Granulated Slag for Manufacture of Portland Slag Cement
technical_requirements.target_product: Specification for Granulated Slag for Manufacture of Portland Slag Cement
technical_requirements.material_grade: Water quenched blast furnace glassy slag
technical_requirements.application: Raw material blending for Portland slag cement (PSC)

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard specification for granulated slag for manufacture of Portland slag cement.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Prescribes the requirements for granulated slag for the manufacture of Portland slag cement.

hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 455 is for finished blended cement, whereas tender is for the raw granulated slag input material (IS 12089).

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Pulverized fuel ash (fly ash) for pozzolana cement.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Fly ash from thermal plants is different from blast furnace iron slag.

query.raw_text: Supply of precast concrete cable covers and protection slabs for protecting buried underground electrical power cables along pipeline right-of-way corridor.

technical_requirements.application: Mechanical protection of buried power cables

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard specification for precast concrete cable covers.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Specifies requirements for precast concrete cable covers intended to provide mechanical protection for buried electric cables.

hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 10418 covers transport wooden/steel drums, not trench protection concrete covers.
IS 2185 is for structural wall masonry blocks, not cable trench covers.

query.raw_text: Supply of single phase a.c. induction motors 230V 50Hz, output rating 1.5 kW foot mounted for domestic water booster pumps in residential colony.

technical_requirements.target_product: Single Phase a.c. Induction Motors for General Purpose

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard for single phase a.c. induction motors for general purpose.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Prescribes the requirements for single-phase AC induction motors for general purpose.

hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Tender asks for single-phase motor, while IS 12615 is strictly for line operated 3-phase induction motors.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Three-phase motors for centrifugal pumps for agricultural applications.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 7538 is for 3-phase agricultural pumps, not single phase domestic motors.

query.raw_text: Procurement of cotton covered copper conductors, round wires and rectangular strips for high-voltage power transformer and stator electrical windings.

technical_requirements.target_product: Cotton Covered Copper Conductors - Specification Part 1 Round Conductors
technical_requirements.material_grade: High conductivity electrolytic copper with double cotton covering
technical_requirements.application: Electrical machine and transformer stator winding

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard for cotton covered copper conductors: Part 1 Round conductors.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1: Prescribes the requirements for cotton covered round copper conductors for electrical windings.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Winding wires for submersible motors standard.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 8783 is specialized polymer/nylon covered wire for submerged motors, not cotton covered conductors.
IS 398 is bare aluminium conductor for outdoor lines, not insulated copper winding wire.
